$comment: What llx-markdown holds itself to. `bun run bench:check` reads results/latest.json and fails on any line it breaks. Change a number only together with the reason in README.md.

rules.about: A token never costs a frame: the 95th percentile update fits in 16.7 ms (60 Hz).
No update is a long task (50 ms) in a reply up to 20k characters.
A reply four times longer costs about four times more to stream, not sixteen: the exponent stays under 1.25.
Not slower than Streamdown, the closest reference, by more than 25% over a whole stream.
Streaming the same reply a second time keeps less than 1 MB more: nothing grows with use. The first stream may warm bounded caches.
